id.description: Unique identifier for the logical object that instance of this type represents.

name.description: The name of the component. Optional field for informational purposes only.

dataSpec.description:
The data settings for this component.

@uiSdlDesignerCustomRenderer(rendererType='')

disableDataRequestOnFirstRender.description: Disable if you want to avoid sending any and all requests for this component on first render.

triggersRegistered.description: Whether the effect triggers and epics have been registered

wrapWithMetadataId.description: Whether to wrap the component with a div which has a class name of its metdata id. Useful for targeting with css.

minValue.description: The minimum value (which results in an empty wheel) for the color wheel.

maxValue.description: The maximum value (which results in a full wheel) for the color wheel.

valueFormatSpec.description:
The configs for how to display the numerical value in the grid.
By default the numbers will display without formatting.

colorThresholds.description:
The configurations for each value threshold. The first min value and the
last max value should be equivalent to `minValue` and `maxValue`, respectively.

fontConfigs.description: The font configurations for the value in the center of the color wheel.

wheelSize.description:
The size of the color wheel in the grid cell.
Diameters of the wheel based on size are as follows:

  sm - 24px (classic) 18px (dense)
  md - 34px (classic) 24px (dense)
  lg - 44px (classic) 30px (dense)

valuePosition.description:
Specifies the position of a value relative to the color wheel: either inside the color wheel or to its right.
@default 'inside'

defaultColors.description: Read-only. The default set of colors to be used for thresholds in the event that none are specified.

title:
Type containing configurations for a value-based color wheel
in a {@link UiSdlDataGrid} cell.
name: UiSdlColorWheelDataGrid
